name: Mandeville Center
provenance: Original 114 Facilities room polygons, supplemented by 11 basement teaching rooms traced from public 2018/2024 master-plan rasters; 2017 L1 raster and shared shafts calibrate the existing mirrored local frame.

coordinateSystem.description: Meters from the center of the building's campus-map footprint.
coordinateSystem.northNote: Scaled from official room areas (1.33 ft per drawing pixel); rotated 360.0 deg (mirrored) and fitted to the campus-map footprint on Level 1 (overlap 0.42). The match is weak, so the building is not placed among its neighbors.

sources.note: Exact printed room label; no inferred prefix or area-based identity matching.

notes: Simplified walls traced from the public master plan dated 2024-09-19.
Traced area 3089.6 sq ft; printed area 3070 sq ft. Area is an independent consistency check, not survey accuracy.

rooms.label: B206

sources.note: Exact printed room label; no inferred prefix or area-based identity matching.

notes: Simplified walls traced from the public master plan dated 2024-09-19.
Traced area 1959.1 sq ft; printed area 1959 sq ft. Area is an independent consistency check, not survey accuracy.

Manually simplified classroom wall boundaries from dated public Facilities master-plan rasters. Perimeter columns, narrow wall recesses, doors and furniture are simplified; these are not measured 3D interiors.

B1 outline covers only four reviewed teaching-wing portions, not the entire basement; unreviewed eastern service areas and unexcavated regions are omitted. B2 uses its visible outer floor envelope. Neither basement reuses the former copied L1 outline.
L1 and L2 room geometry and all 114 pre-existing room objects are preserved. L1 raster is calibration evidence only. L2 room 212 remains unplaced.

Registration is into the original mirrored local coordinate frame. No campus longitude/latitude or absolute north correction is added. Exact reflected transforms and independent checks are recorded in the review JSON.
FIS warns its viewer imagery may be out of date; current CAD-vault/Tririga export remains unavailable. Different drawing revisions are stated individually.
